name: cinecria-mobile
description: Cinecria para Android — mesma UI e mesmo WebRTC do desktop, empacotados com Capacitor.

scripts.setup: npm run web && npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.sync: npm run web && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.js
scripts.run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleRelease
